anna: Heads-up — PR #11888 is blocked by CI. integration/shard-7 has a flaky failure that repros intermittently locally. @mike can you kick a targeted rerun? cc @jordan for the snapshot/timing check
ci-bot: circleci: job integration/shard-7 failed (exit code 1). Logs: https://ci.internal/11888/shard-7. Re-run suggestion: `circleci retry 11888 --job integration/shard-7`
mike: on it, running the targeted rerun now
mike: ```
$ circleci retry 11888 --job integration/shard-7
Queued build: 11888-2
```
ci-bot: Re-run queued (build 11888-2).
ci-bot: build 11888-2: integration/shard-7 STILL failing: `test_pm_kv_timeout` -> AssertionError: expected 0 but got 1. Suspected timing jitter. Full log: https://ci.internal/11888-2/logs
jordan: Looks like the kv-prefetch timing jitter we saw last week. I can either bump the timeout or mark it flaky-on-ci. Anna — prefer snapshot update or a small test fix?
anna: Prefer not to update snapshots for a timing jitter. Jordan, can you add an explicit `xfail_on_ci` or increase the timeout slightly? If you push that small change I'll approve once CI is green. Also need one more approval from @sara before merge. :thumbsup:
sara: I can give approval after we get a green run or an explicit CI-only skip. If Jordan pushes the fix, @mike please re-run the shard and then I'll review+approve.
jordan: I'll open a tiny follow-up PR (11889) to add `@pytest.mark.flaky_on_ci` + timeout bump. Pushing in ~20m.
mike: copy — will watch and re-run `merge_when_green` after the new commit lands.
anna: thanks all. ci-bot please trigger reruns automatically when PR 11889 is merged and post back here. :rocket:
